unitTitle: Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 2-unit (Night and Day) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: chastota ravishlari, Past Simple, used to.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 2-UNIT NAZARIYA (10-bet, PDF 9). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '2', sarlavha: 'Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor'. Och pushti ramka, ikki ustun.

CHAP USTUN:
'Adverbs of Frequency': Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never) usually come before the main verb but after the auxiliary verb (do, does, etc) and the verb to be. Adverbs of frequency tell us how often something happens. 'I never work on Saturdays. She rarely takes the train. He sometimes goes to the cinema. Do you often watch TV in the evening? Tom is usually late for school.'
'Past Simple: regular verbs' jadvali: Affirmative: I/you/he/she/it/we/you/they worked. Interrogative: Did I/you/he/she/it/we/you/they work? Negative: I/you/he/she/it/we/you/they didn't work.
'Short answers': Did I/you/he, etc work ...? - Yes, I/you/he, etc did. No, I/you/he, etc didn't.
'Form': • We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. 'I work - I worked' • Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. 'I sing - I sang' (see list of irregular verbs at the back of the book) • We form the interrogative of the past simple with did + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. 'Did he play football yesterday? Did he go swimming last week?' • We form the negative of the past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. 'I didn't play football yesterday. I didn't go swimming last week.' • We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. '"Did you get up early?" "Yes, I did." "Did he watch TV?" "No, he didn't."'

O'NG USTUN:
'Spelling': • We add -d to verbs ending in -e. 'I live - I lived' • Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. 'I try - I tried' • Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and add -ed. 'I stop - I stopped'
'Use': We use the past simple for: • actions which happened or finished at a definite time in the past. 'Lisa bought a house last year. (When? Last year.)' • actions which happened repeatedly in the past but don't happen anymore. In this case we can use adverbs of frequency (always, often, usually etc). 'He usually played football in his free time. (but he doesn't play football anymore.)'
'Time expressions we use with the past simple': yesterday, last night/week/year/month, etc, a month/two years/three years, etc ago, in 1964, etc. 'Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.'
'Used to': Used to is used to talk about past habits or things that do not happen anymore. It has the same form in all persons, singular and plural and it is followed by infinitive. 'Sarah used to drink a lot of coffee. (Sarah doesn't drink a lot of coffee anymore.)' We form questions and negations with the auxiliary verb did/did not (didn't), the subject and the verb "use" without -d. 'Did Sarah use to drink a lot of coffee? Sarah didn't use to drink a lot of coffee.' To talk about past habits that do not happen any more we can use the past simple instead of "used to" with no difference in meaning. 'He used to live in a flat. ALSO: He lived in a flat.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '10'.

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never) usually come before the main verb but after the auxiliary verb (do, does, etc) and the verb to be. Adverbs of frequency tell us how often something happens. I never work on Saturdays. She rarely takes the train. He sometimes goes to the cinema. Do you often watch TV in the evening? Tom is usually late for school.
exercises.instructionUz: Chastota ravishlari (always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never) odatda asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan KEYIN keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi. Men shanba kunlari hech qachon ishlamayman. U kamdan-kam poyezdga chiqadi. U ba'zan kinoga boradi. Kechqurun tez-tez televizor ko'rasizmi? Tom odatda maktabga kech qoladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
ChASTOTA RAVIShLARI - QANChALIK
  TEZ-TEZ?

  100% always      = har doim
       usually     = odatda
       often       = tez-tez
       sometimes   = ba'zan
       occasionally = vaqti-vaqti
                      bilan
       rarely      = kamdan-kam
    0% never       = hech qachon


O'RNI - 3 QOIDA:

  1) ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     I NEVER work on Saturdays.
     She RARELY takes the train.
     He SOMETIMES goes to the
     cinema.

  2) YORDAMChI FE'LDAN KEYIN:
     Do you OFTEN watch TV?

  3) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     Tom is USUALLY late.


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:

  'I work never' ✗
  'Tom usually is late' ✗
  → ravish 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ 'NEVER' - INKOR:

  'I never work' - 'don't' KERAK
  EMAS ('I don't never work' ✗).

points.en: always — usually — often — sometimes — occasionally — rarely — never
points.uz: har doim - odatda - tez-tez - ba'zan - vaqti-vaqti bilan - kamdan-kam - hech qachon

points.en: I never work on Saturdays. She rarely takes the train. He sometimes goes to the cinema. (before the main verb)
Do you often watch TV in the evening? (after the auxiliary verb)
Tom is usually late for school. (after the verb to be)

exercises.instructionEn: Regular verbs: I/you/he/she/it/we/they worked. Interrogative: Did I/you/he ... work? Negative: I/you/he ... didn't work. Short answers: Did you work? - Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. Form: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb (I work - I worked). Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms (I sing - I sang; see list of irregular verbs at the back of the book). Interrogative: did + subject pronoun + base form: Did he play football yesterday? Did he go swimming last week? Negative: didn't + base form: I didn't play football yesterday. I didn't go swimming last week. Short answers: 'Did you get up early?' 'Yes, I did.' 'Did he watch TV?' 'No, he didn't.'
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri fe'llar: I/you/he/she/it/we/they worked. So'roq: Did I/you/he ... work? Inkor: I/you/he ... didn't work. Qisqa javob: Did you work? - Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. Shakl: ko'p to'g'ri fe'llarning tasdiq shakli -ed qo'shib yasaladi (I work - I worked). Boshqa fe'llar noto'g'ri tasdiq shakliga ega (I sing - I sang; kitob oxiridagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang). So'roq: did + ega + fe'l asosiy shakli: U kecha futbol o'ynadimi? U o'tgan hafta suzishga bordimi? Inkor: didn't + fe'l asosiy shakli: Men kecha futbol o'ynamadim. Qisqa javob: 'Erta turdingmi?' 'Ha.' 'U televizor ko'rdimi?' 'Yo'q.'
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE - ShAKLI.

  TASDIQ - HAMMA ShAXSDA BIR XIL:
    I / you / he / she / it / we /
    they WORKED
    ⚠ 3-shaxsda -s YO'Q!

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: + -ed
    work → worked
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: alohida shakl
    sing → sang, go → went, buy →
    bought (kitob oxiridagi jadval)

  SO'ROQ: DID + ega + fe'l ASOSIY
    shakli
    Did he PLAY football yesterday?
    Did he GO swimming last week?
    ⚠ 'Did he played' ✗ - 'did'
    bo'lsa fe'l o'zgarmaydi!

  INKOR: DIDN'T + fe'l asosiy
    shakli
    I didn't PLAY football.
    I didn't GO swimming.

  QISQA JAVOB:
    Did you get up early? - Yes, I
    DID. / No, I DIDN'T.


⚠ -ED FAQAT BIR JOYDA:

  Tasdiqda fe'lda (played);
  so'roq/inkorda 'did'da - fe'l
  asosiy shaklda.

points.en: I worked — Did I work? — I didn't work (same for all persons)
points.uz: Tasdiq - so'roq - inkor (hamma shaxsda bir xil)

points.en: I work - I worked (regular: -ed); I sing - I sang (irregular)
points.uz: To'g'ri fe'l: -ed; noto'g'ri fe'l: alohida shakl

points.en: Did he play football yesterday? Did he go swimming last week?
points.uz: So'roq: did + ega + fe'l asosiy shakli

points.en: I didn't play football yesterday. I didn't go swimming last week.
'Did you get up early?' 'Yes, I did.' 'Did he watch TV?' 'No, he didn't.'

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: We add -d to verbs ending in -e (I live - I lived). Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied (I try - I tried). Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and add -ed (I stop - I stopped).
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: -e bilan tugaydigan fe'llarga -d qo'shiladi (I live - I lived). Undosh + y bilan tugaydiganlar -y ni tashlab -ied oladi (I try - I tried). Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugaydiganlar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantirib -ed oladi (I stop - I stopped).
exercises.explanationUz:
-ED IMLOSI - 3 QOIDA.

  1) -e BILAN TUGASA: + -d
     live → lived, love → loved

  2) UNDOSh + y: -y → -ied
     try → tried, study → studied
     ⚠ unli + y: play → played
     (o'zgarmaydi)

  3) UNDOSh + URG'ULI UNLI +
     UNDOSh: oxirgi undosh
     IKKILANADI
     stop → stoPPed, plan → plaNNed
     ⚠ visit → visited (urg'u
     birinchi bo'g'inda -
     ikkilanmaydi)

points.en: verbs ending in -e: + -d — I live - I lived
consonant + y → -ied — I try - I tried
one stressed vowel between two consonants → double consonant + -ed — I stop - I stopped
points.uz: Undosh + urg'uli unli + undosh → undosh ikkilanadi

exercises.instructionEn: Use: We use the past simple for actions which happened or finished at a definite time in the past: Lisa bought a house last year. (When? Last year.); and for actions which happened repeatedly in the past but don't happen anymore (we can use adverbs of frequency): He usually played football in his free time. (but he doesn't play football anymore.) Time expressions: yesterday, last night/week/year/month, a month/two years/three years ago, in 1964, etc. Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi: Past simple o'tmishda aniq vaqtda bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun: Liza o'tgan yili uy sotib oldi. (Qachon? O'tgan yili.); va o'tmishda takror bo'lgan, lekin endi bo'lmaydigan harakatlar uchun (chastota ravishlari bilan): U odatda bo'sh vaqtida futbol o'ynardi. (lekin endi o'ynamaydi.) Vaqt ifodalari: yesterday, last night/week/year/month, a month/two years ago, in 1964 va h.k. Fleming penitsillinni 1928-yilda kashf etgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE QAChON:

  1) O'TMIShDA ANIQ VAQTDA bo'lgan /
     tugagan harakat:
     Lisa BOUGHT a house LAST
     YEAR. (Qachon? - o'tgan yili)

  2) O'TMIShDAGI TAKRORLANGAN
     harakat (endi yo'q):
     He usually PLAYED football in
     his free time. (endi
     o'ynamaydi)


VAQT SO'ZLARI (belgilar):

  yesterday - kecha
  last night / week / year / month
    - o'tgan ...
  a month / two years ago - ...
    oldin
  in 1964 - yilda

  Fleming discovered penicillin IN
  1928.


⚠ 'AGO' OXIRIDA:

  'two years ago' (ago two years
  ✗).

points.en: Lisa bought a house last year. (When? Last year.) — definite time in the past
points.uz: Liza o'tgan yili uy sotib oldi. - o'tmishda aniq vaqt

points.en: He usually played football in his free time. (but he doesn't play football anymore.) — repeated action in the past
points.uz: U odatda futbol o'ynardi. (endi o'ynamaydi) - o'tmishdagi takror harakat

points.en: yesterday, last night/week/year/month, two years ago, in 1964 — Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.

exercises.instructionEn: Used to is used to talk about past habits or things that do not happen anymore. It has the same form in all persons, singular and plural and it is followed by infinitive. Sarah used to drink a lot of coffee. (Sarah doesn't drink a lot of coffee anymore.) We form questions and negations with the auxiliary verb did/did not (didn't), the subject and the verb 'use' without -d: Did Sarah use to drink a lot of coffee? Sarah didn't use to drink a lot of coffee. To talk about past habits that do not happen any more we can use the past simple instead of 'used to' with no difference in meaning: He used to live in a flat. ALSO: He lived in a flat.
exercises.instructionUz: Used to - o'tmishdagi odatlar yoki endi bo'lmaydigan narsalar haqida gapirish uchun. Hamma shaxsda, birlik va ko'plikda bir xil shakl, keyin infinitiv keladi. Sara ilgari ko'p qahva ichardi. (Sara endi ko'p qahva ichmaydi.) Savol va inkor did/didn't yordamchi fe'li, ega va -d siz 'use' fe'li bilan yasaladi: Sara ilgari ko'p qahva icharmidi? Sara ilgari ko'p qahva ichmasdi. Endi bo'lmaydigan o'tmish odatlari haqida 'used to' o'rniga past simple ham ishlatiladi - ma'no farqi yo'q: U ilgari kvartirada yashardi. ShUNINGDEK: U kvartirada yashagan.
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO - ILGARI ... EDI (ENDI
  YO'Q).

  ShAKL: used to + FE'L (asosiy)
  Hamma shaxsda BIR XIL:
    I / she / they USED TO drink

  Sarah USED TO drink a lot of
  coffee. (endi ichmaydi)

  SO'ROQ: Did + ega + USE to ...?
    Did Sarah USE to drink ...?
  INKOR: didn't + USE to
    Sarah DIDN'T USE to drink ...

  ⚠ Savol va inkorda 'USE' (-d
  SIZ)! 'didn't used to' ✗


PAST SIMPLE BILAN BIR XIL:

  He USED TO live in a flat.
  = He LIVED in a flat.
  (ma'no farqi yo'q)


⚠ 'USED TO' FAQAT O'TMISh:

  Hozirgi odat uchun 'use to' YO'Q
  - 'usually' ishlatiladi.

points.en: Sarah used to drink a lot of coffee. (Sarah doesn't drink a lot of coffee anymore.)
points.uz: Sara ilgari ko'p qahva ichardi. (endi ichmaydi)

points.en: Did Sarah use to drink a lot of coffee? — Sarah didn't use to drink a lot of coffee.
points.uz: So'roq va inkor: did / didn't + use to (-d siz)

points.en: He used to live in a flat. ALSO: He lived in a flat. (no difference in meaning)
points.uz: used to = past simple (ma'no farqi yo'q)

sentencePatterns.introUz: Chastota ravishlari, Past Simple, used to.

patterns.formula: KIM + RAVISh + FE'L / KIM + is + RAVISh + ...
patterns.exampleEn: I never work on Saturdays. Tom is usually late for school.
patterns.exampleUz: Men shanba kunlari hech qachon ishlamayman. Tom odatda maktabga kech qoladi.

patterns.formula: KIM + FE'L-ed / NOTO'G'RI ShAKL + VAQT (last year, ago, in 1928)
patterns.exampleEn: Lisa bought a house last year. Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.
patterns.exampleUz: Liza o'tgan yili uy sotib oldi. Fleming penitsillinni 1928-yilda kashf etgan.

patterns.formula: Did + KIM + FE'L? — KIM + didn't + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Did he play football yesterday? I didn't go swimming last week.
patterns.exampleUz: U kecha futbol o'ynadimi? Men o'tgan hafta suzishga bormadim.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ So'roq va inkor - fe'l asosiy shaklda.

patterns.formula: KIM + used to + FE'L / Did + KIM + use to + FE'L?
patterns.exampleEn: Sarah used to drink a lot of coffee. Did Sarah use to drink a lot of coffee?
patterns.exampleUz: Sara ilgari ko'p qahva ichardi. Sara ilgari ko'p qahva icharmidi?
